registry.name: search_web
registry.description: Search public internet sources for recent or general factual information such as news, public company details, and public websites.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to retrieve.

examples.user: Find recent public news about Tesla layoffs.

registry.name: search_database
registry.description: Search structured internal database records such as customers, products, transactions, and CRM entities.

entity_type.description: The database entity family to search.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

examples.user: Look up customer record for Olivia Chen in the CRM.

registry.name: query_internal_docs
registry.description: Search internal SOPs, policy documents, onboarding guides, and internal knowledge-base articles.

query.description: The internal documentation question or keyword query.

department.description: Optional department namespace for the query.

examples.user: Find the internal PTO carryover policy.

registry.name: query_order_status
registry.description: Retrieve the current fulfillment or shipping status for one specific order by order ID.

examples.user: Check the shipping status for order ORD-10428.

registry.name: update_order
registry.description: Change the status or internal note for an existing order record when the order ID and new status are explicitly provided.

note.description: Optional operator note explaining the change.

examples.user: Mark order ORD-10428 as shipped and add note handed to courier.

registry.name: book_flight
registry.description: Book a flight when travel date, flight number, origin, and destination are all provided clearly.

examples.user: Book flight MU123 on 2026-05-12 from Shanghai to Beijing in economy.

registry.name: change_flight
registry.description: Change an existing flight reservation when the booking ID and requested new date are explicitly provided.

new_date.description: New desired travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

examples.user: Move booking BK-8831 to 2026-05-15 because the meeting changed.

registry.name: create_support_ticket
registry.description: Create a support ticket when the user identity, category, priority, and problem description are available.

examples.user: Open a high-priority technical ticket for user U-204 because the app keeps crashing on login.

registry.name: get_weather
registry.description: Get the weather forecast for a specified city and optionally a date.

date.description: Optional forecast date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

examples.user: What is the weather in Hangzhou tomorrow?

registry.name: translate_text
registry.description: Translate a given text string into a specified target language.

target_lang.description: Target language code or language name.

examples.user: Translate 'meeting delayed by 20 minutes' to Chinese.

enhanced.name: search_web

enhanced.name: search_database

entity_type.description: The database entity family to search.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

examples.user: Look up customer record for Olivia Chen in the CRM.

department.description: Optional department namespace for the query.
